faqs.q: Sec. 42-61. - I.F.C. Section 510.4.1.2, Minimum signal strength out of the building.
faqs.a:
Section 510.4.1.2 Minimum signal strength out of the building
, is amended in its entirety to read as follows:
"510.4.1.2 Minimum signal strength out of the building.
A minimum signal strength of -95 dBm shall be received by the agency's radio system
                  when transmitted from within the building."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
